subject: Stakeholder map & mutual action plan (MAP) - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today, Oliver — appreciate the thoughtful run-through of FinPay's priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Oliver Grant (you) — main decision criteria: latency under 200ms for common flows, predictable per-token cost, and support for private deployment options.
- Security/compliance: Sofia Martinez (cc) will own the controls checklist and will need SOC2 evidence + data residency details.
- Procurement: Kevin Liu (you indicated) will manage contracting and PO process; timeline impacted by their procurement cycle (~3-4 weeks once SOW is finalized).

Proposed MAP (attached stub): milestone 1 = security review (Sofia + Redwood security packet) by Apr 8; milestone 2 = pilot (1 week, target infra) by Apr 22; milestone 3 = commercial terms & PO by May 6.

Next steps: 
1) We will send a first-pass MAP + SOW draft (Camila to own technical scope, Marissa to own commercial).
2) Sofia: sharing list of required artifacts (SOC2, audit logs, encryption details) would be great — we'll compile a security packet.
3) Kevin/Procurement: any contractual constraints or preferred templates (MSA/PO) please share so we can align the SOW.

Attachments: FinPay - MAP v1.xlsx (first-pass), SOC2_Attestation.pdf (Redwood public attestation).

If that looks right, I'll update the MAP and send for review by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment(s): FinPay - MAP v1.xlsx (stated scope / milestones), SOC2_Attestation.pdf (Redwood public SOC2 statement)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@finpay.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Thanks Marissa — solid recap. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Timeline: procurement windows are tight — if we can get a clean SOW and commercial by Apr 12 we can aim to sign and have infra in place by end of April.
- Commercial ask: can you include a pilot discount and an optional expansion pricing band for committed capacity? We'll need line-item pricing for pilot vs production.
- Procurement: CC'd Kevin — Kevin, we'd like you to review Redwood's MSA/PO terms. If you need a redline, please flag by Apr 6.

Sofia — thanks for owning security. Please let us know if Redwood needs to complete an external questionnaire or if a self-service security packet suffices.

Oliver
VP Product | FinPay Inc.
oliver.grant@finpay.com | +1 (212) 555-0987

Hi Marissa / Camila — thanks for the summary. For security review I need:

1) Redwood SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months) or a link to your attestation.
2) Data residency options and whether customer data can be pinned to a US region.
3) Details on audit logs (retention period, access controls) and key management (KMS/HSM options).
4) Any FedRAMP / regional compliance notes (if applicable).

If you can send a single packet / folder with the above, that will speed the internal review.

Also — please note we will run a brief security review during the pilot that must pass before production rollout. Target completion date for our end: Apr 8.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Security | FinPay Inc.
sofia.martinez@finpay.com

Team — following the external thread, I pulled together a cleaned-up MAP and a draft technical scope. Action items: 

- Camila: I will finalize the technical scope (in-scope API endpoints, expected qps, latency SLOs) and validate infra requirements with infra team by Apr 4. (owner = me)
- Marissa: I'll need you to take the commercial template and draft pilot pricing + expansion bands; include proposed discount for pilot. (owner = Marissa)
- Laura: You should prepare a one-page onboarding timeline and success metrics we'll measure during the pilot (owner = Laura)
- Priyom: Please review any unusual commercial concessions and confirm approval threshold.

I attached the first-pass MAP (FinPay - MAP v1.xlsx) — it's intentionally a short milestone list so we can agree quickly. I'll upload a live Drive link after we incorporate Marissa's commercial info.

Subject: MAP update + SOW draft link and next milestones

Oliver / team — updated MAP and next steps below. Thanks to Camila for the technical scope draft and Sofia for the security checklist. Attached: updated MAP (now includes pilot pricing rows) and a link to the SOW draft.

Key updates:
- Security packet: uploaded SOC2 attestation and KMS details here: https://drive.google.com/finpay/MAP/v1 (Redwood — SOC2_Attestation.pdf included). Target: FinPay security sign-off by Apr 8.
- SOW draft: https://www.docusign.com/packet/0a1b2c3d (placeholder for review; will convert to DocuSign once legal review is complete).
- Pilot plan: 1-week pilot starting Apr 19 (target infra ready Apr 16). Scope: up to 200k tokens/day, 99th pctl latency <200ms for top flows.
- Commercials: pilot discount 25% off list for the pilot period; expansion pricing bands included in MAP. Please review and let me know if these work for procurement.

Next actions: 
1) Kevin — can you confirm procurement's preferred contracting template and any required insurance limits by Apr 6?
2) Sofia — let us know if the security packet is sufficient or if you need further artifacts by Apr 5.
3) Camila/Laura — finalize pilot runbook and success metrics by Apr 8.
4) Oliver — if the above aligns, we'll target DocuSign send for the SOW week of Apr 12.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15 min call if useful to align on timelines.

Best,
Marissa Cole
